
## App Bars

Give each screen a clear identity, with headers for search, focused work, and navigation.

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ahmedelsapagh10/flutter_ui_gallery/design-overhaul/doc/assets/showcase-v021/header.searchSwitch.webp" alt="Search Switch — actual Flutter app bars preview" width="440">

**Copy & Use — Search Switch**

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_ui_gallery/flutter_ui_gallery.dart';

Widget showHeaderSearchSwitch(
  VoidCallback onNotifications,
  ValueChanged<String> onSearchChanged,
) {
  return Scaffold(
    appBar: UiGalleryAppBar(
      preset: UiGalleryAppBarPreset.searchSwitch,
      title: const Text("Notebook"),
      subtitle: const Text("Ideas worth keeping"),
      scrollAware: true,
      onSearchChanged: onSearchChanged,
      actions: [
        IconButton(
          onPressed: onNotifications,
          icon: const Icon(Icons.notifications_none_rounded),
        ),
      ],
      style: const UiGallerySurfaceStyle(accentColor: Color(0xff007f88)),
    ),
  );
}
```

**Customize:** `title`, `subtitle`, `leading`, `actions`, `bottom`, `scrollAware`, and `style`.

## Toasts

Keep people informed with compact feedback, recovery actions, and live progress.

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ahmedelsapagh10/flutter_ui_gallery/design-overhaul/doc/assets/showcase-v021/toasts.action.webp" alt="Action Capsule — actual Flutter toasts preview" width="440">

**Copy & Use — Action Capsule**

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_ui_gallery/flutter_ui_gallery.dart';

void showToastsAction(BuildContext context, VoidCallback onUndo) {
  UiGalleryToast.show(
    context,
    preset: UiGalleryToastPreset.action,
    message: "Your changes are saved and ready.",
    kind: UiGalleryToastKind.success,
    actionLabel: 'Undo',
    onAction: onUndo,
    showProgress: true,
    style: const UiGallerySurfaceStyle(accentColor: Color(0xff007f88)),
  );
}
```

**Customize:** `kind`, `position`, `duration`, `actionLabel` / `onAction`, `style`, and `motion`.

## Bottom Sheets

Bring contextual actions, forms, and useful details into reach without leaving the screen.

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ahmedelsapagh10/flutter_ui_gallery/design-overhaul/doc/assets/showcase-v021/sheets.orbit.webp" alt="Orbit Dock — actual Flutter bottom sheets preview" width="440">

**Copy & Use — Orbit Dock**

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_ui_gallery/flutter_ui_gallery.dart';

Future<void> showSheetsOrbit(BuildContext context) async {
  await UiGallerySheet.show<void>(
    context: context,
    preset: UiGallerySheetPreset.orbit,
    header: const Text("Field notes"),
    child: const Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text('A quiet place for your next idea.'),
        SizedBox(height: 16),
        ListTile(
          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
          leading: Icon(Icons.bookmark_outline),
          title: Text('Personal collection'),
          subtitle: Text('12 notes · Only you'),
        ),
        ListTile(
          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
          leading: Icon(Icons.groups_outlined),
          title: Text('Team workspace'),
          subtitle: Text('Shared with your team'),
        ),
      ],
    ),
    footer: Builder(
      builder: (sheetContext) => FilledButton(
        onPressed: () => Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop(),
        child: const Text('Done'),
      ),
    ),
    style: const UiGallerySurfaceStyle(accentColor: Color(0xff007f88)),
  );
}
```

**Customize:** `header`, `child`, `footer`, `style`, `appearance`, and `motion`.

## Dialogs

Make decisions easier with clear choices, searchable commands, and focused results.

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ahmedelsapagh10/flutter_ui_gallery/design-overhaul/doc/assets/showcase-v021/dialogs.sideBySideChoice.webp" alt="Side-by-Side Choice — actual Flutter dialogs preview" width="440">

**Copy & Use — Side-by-Side Choice**

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_ui_gallery/flutter_ui_gallery.dart';

Future<String?> showDialogsSideBySideChoice(BuildContext context) {
  return UiGalleryDialog.show<String>(
    context: context,
    useRootNavigator: false,
    preset: UiGalleryDialogPreset.sideBySideChoice,
    title: "Make room for your next idea",
    message: "Keep your ideas together. Choose how to continue.",
    actions: const [
      UiGalleryDialogAction(
        label: 'Personal',
        value: 'Personal',
        description: 'A private space for your own projects.',
        icon: Icon(Icons.person_outline),
      ),
      UiGalleryDialogAction(
        label: 'Team',
        value: 'Team',
        primary: true,
        description: 'Share collections with collaborators.',
        icon: Icon(Icons.groups_outlined),
      ),
    ],
    style: const UiGallerySurfaceStyle(accentColor: Color(0xff007f88)),
  );
}
```

**Customize:** `title`, `message`, `actions`, `child`, `result`, `style`, and `motion`.

## Bottom Navigation

Keep primary destinations visible with selection-aware bars, docks, and shelves.

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ahmedelsapagh10/flutter_ui_gallery/design-overhaul/doc/assets/showcase-v021/bottomNav.morphingCapsule.webp" alt="Morphing Capsule — actual Flutter bottom navigation preview" width="440">

**Copy & Use — Morphing Capsule**

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_ui_gallery/flutter_ui_gallery.dart';

Widget showBottomNavMorphingCapsule(int index, ValueChanged<int> onSelected) {
  return UiGalleryBottomNav(
    preset: UiGalleryBottomNavPreset.morphingCapsule,
    selectedIndex: index,
    onDestinationSelected: onSelected,
    items: const [
      UiGalleryBottomNavItem(
        icon: Icon(Icons.explore_outlined),
        selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.explore),
        label: 'Discover',
      ),
      UiGalleryBottomNavItem(
        icon: Icon(Icons.bookmark_border),
        selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.bookmark),
        label: 'Saved',
        badge: Text('3'),
      ),
      UiGalleryBottomNavItem(
        icon: Icon(Icons.inbox_outlined),
        selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.inbox),
        label: 'Inbox',
        badge: Text('2'),
      ),
      UiGalleryBottomNavItem(
        icon: Icon(Icons.timeline),
        label: 'Activity',
        enabled: false,
      ),
    ],
    style: const UiGallerySurfaceStyle(accentColor: Color(0xff007f88)),
  );
}
```

**Customize:** `items`, `selectedIndex`, `onDestinationSelected`, `centerAction`, `options`, and `style`.

## Customization

**Minimal** keeps surfaces precise. **Soft** adds comfortable geometry.
**Spatial** adds restrained depth. Each family uses the host `ColorScheme` and
`TextTheme`. Optional signatures add the family treatment; choosing a family
alone leaves signatures off. These screenshots use Soft with signatures on.

```dart
ThemeData galleryTheme() {
  final base = ThemeData(colorSchemeSeed: const Color(0xff007f88));
  return base.copyWith(
    extensions: [
      UiGalleryTheme.family(
        UiGalleryDesignFamily.soft,
        theme: base,
        useSignature: true,
      ),
    ],
  );
}
```

Apply it to `MaterialApp(theme: galleryTheme())`. Configure `darkTheme` from a dark
base theme too. Per-call `style` and `motion` override inherited defaults;
reduced-motion preferences still apply.

[Theme, style, and motion options](https://github.com/Ahmedelsapagh10/flutter_ui_gallery/blob/design-overhaul/doc/USAGE.md) ·
[Signatures and override precedence](https://github.com/Ahmedelsapagh10/flutter_ui_gallery/blob/design-overhaul/doc/FAMILY_SIGNATURES.md)
